base_source.excerpt: Electrical fit-out to the issued floor plan, AUD 4,800 ex GST. After-hours attendance and disposal are outside this scope.

messages.name: Sam Reed
messages.body: The foyer is occupied during the day. We can bring the crew back after closing on Thursday for $400 ex GST. Should I book that slot?

messages.name: Jo Bell
messages.body: Yes, I approve $400 ex GST for the crew to come back after closing on Thursday at Banksia Rooms. Please book it.

threads.subject: Old light fittings at Banksia Rooms

messages.name: Jo Bell
messages.body: Could you price collection of the old fittings at Banksia Rooms? Please send the figure before booking.

messages.name: Sam Reed
messages.body: Collection would be $200 ex GST. I'll wait for your confirmation.

messages.name: Sam Reed
messages.body: The extra evening visit to Fern Hall on Wednesday is $400 ex GST. Can we go ahead?

messages.name: Jo Bell
messages.body: Approved for $400 ex GST at Fern Hall. Book the Wednesday evening visit.

messages.name: Sam Reed
messages.body: Two ways to finish at Banksia Rooms. We can come back after closing on Thursday for $400 ex GST, or bring an extra installer during normal hours on Friday for $400 ex GST. Which should I book?
